[size=3][b]REQUIREMENTS[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url]﻿[/*]
[/list]
[size=3][b]HOW TO INSTALL[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3]Install the latest version of SMAPI. Open the folder you downloaded. Click on whichever "install" file is referring to your Operational System (MacOS, Windows...). A black screen will open. Read the text: it will ask where you'd like to install - you may type 1 then enter. It will then ask whether you want to install or remove it - you may type 1 then enter. [/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Unpack the ZIP file of this mod. Inside that folder, copy the folder named "Portraiture_RukaBravo_1.6".[/size][/*]
[*]Paste that folder into your Mods folder, somewhat at this path:
[i]\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods[/i]
[size=3]4. [u]This step is important![/u] In the folder "[u]Portraits[/u]":
﻿  ﻿If you're playing [b]WITHOUT[/b] SV Expanded mod, you'll DELETE the folder "RukaBravo_SVE"
﻿﻿  ﻿If you're playing [b]WITH[/b] SV Expanded mod, you'll DELETE the folder "RukaBravo_Vanilla"[/size]
5. Run the game using SMAPI (the pufferfish/chicken icon). Have fun!

[i]NOTE: I already put the Portraiture mod INSIDE my files. You don't need to download Portraiture and do all the shenanigans from Portraiture mod. To make it easier for players who are not familiar with modding. Thank you to Plotonymous for creating PORTRAITURE mod! If you know how to use Portraiture, you can open my files and simply copy the folder RukaBravo to your own Portraiture mod file.[/i][/*]
[/list]

FAQ
Does it work for 1.6 update?
Yes!

Is it compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded?
Yes! Today (December 8th, 2025) I finished all SVE portraits. Thank you to my Patreon supporters!

Is it compatible with Ridgeside Village?
Yes, you can play with that mod installed, but the portraits are not ready. I am currently working on those portraits on my [b][url=https://www.patreon.com/c/rukabravo]Patreon[/url][/b]. These portraits are patron-only while the project is in progress and you check which villagers are already done [b][url=https://www.patreon.com/c/rukabravo/about]here[/url][/b]. Once all of them are finished, I'll upload them here on Nexus as well!

Is it compatible with Seasonal Outfits?
Yes. Their sprites will work normally, but with my portraits. To have portraits with custom clothes, I'd have to redraw 4 more portrait sheets for each of the characters, and that would take years and that's not on my plans.
